title: Lutnick Faces Questions Over Nvidia Ties and China Export Pressure
summary: CNBC reported that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is facing scrutiny over his sons&\#x27; firm Cantor Fitzgerald&\#x27;s ties to Nvidia, including a nearly 50% decline in the Nvidia shares it reported holding between September 2025 and March 2026, while he resisted pressure to crack down on suspected Nvidia chip smuggling to China.
